major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it before your other cooldowns so Execution Sentence, Wake of Ashes and your on-use trinkets all run inside it, and never hold it 30 seconds to line up a desynced trinket.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 31884 is the cast id seen in every sampled parse; 292266 and 384376 share the name and were not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Execution Sentence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it as Wake of Ashes comes off cooldown so the burst lands inside its window, and keep cleaving on multiple targets since all damage to the targets you hit feeds the funnel.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 343527 is the cast id; 1260251 is the enemy debuff and 1234189 the self aura.

major_cooldowns.name: Wake of Ashes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Bank 2 Holy Power before you press it, counting the Holy Power Crusading Strikes is about to give you, so Hammer of Light is castable immediately after.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it once Avenging Wrath and Wake of Ashes are rolling, and delay it a few seconds when a pack of adds is about to spawn.

defensives.name: Divine Shield
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to walk through a hit that would otherwise kill you or to buy time when no healer can reach you.

defensives.name: Divine Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Use it on every telegraphed raid hit; the short cooldown brings it back for the next one.
defensives.id_note: 403876 is the id seen in casts; 498 shares the name and was not observed.

defensives.name: Blessing of Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Put it on yourself or a dying ally to shrug off heavy physical damage.

defensives.name: Lay on Hands
defensives.usage_rule: Save it as a full heal for yourself or a raid member who is about to die.
defensives.id_note: 633 is the id seen in casts; 283630 and 471195 share the name and were not observed.

rules.description: Open Blade of Justice into Avenging Wrath and cooldowns
rules.action: Apply Blade of Justice first, then Avenging Wrath with your on-use trinkets, then Execution Sentence into Wake of Ashes and Divine Toll.

rules.description: Hammer of Light right after every Wake of Ashes
rules.action: Bank 2 Holy Power before Wake of Ashes so Hammer of Light fires on the next global.

rules.description: Execution Sentence right before Wake of Ashes
rules.action: Hold Execution Sentence until Wake of Ashes is about to come up so its burst lands inside the window.

rules.description: Hold Execution Sentence and Divine Toll for Avenging Wrath
rules.action: Let them wait the few seconds until Avenging Wrath is up so the whole set runs inside it.

rules.description: Spend Art of War procs with Blade of Justice
rules.action: Press Blade of Justice as soon as Art of War procs and never let the buff sit at its 2 stack cap.

rules.description: Never press Blade of Justice at capped Holy Power
rules.action: Dump your Holy Power with Final Verdict first so none of the Holy Power from Blade of Justice is lost.

rules.description: Swap to Divine Storm as your AoE finisher
rules.action: Spend Holy Power on Divine Storm instead of Final Verdict from 2 targets up.

source_summary: Retribution stacks its 30 and 60 second cooldowns into one window: Avenging Wrath goes first alongside on-use trinkets, then Execution Sentence straight into Wake of Ashes, with Divine Toll behind them. Wake of Ashes is entered with Holy Power already banked so Hammer of Light lands on the next global, while free Light's Deliverance procs are held for an Avenging Wrath window or spent before Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence expire. Everything between cooldowns is Holy Power economy: spend at 5 with Final Verdict, swap to Divine Storm from 2 targets up, and press Blade of Justice on Art of War procs without ever generating over the cap.
